title: feat(nfplus): unique P_+ along n: reverse and face none
science: Same configuration and same kernel as #7059 but the selector picks the single letter P_+ along n whenever n != 0, so there is exactly one combination and reverse=face=`none`. Demonstrates directly that switching from the two-letter to the one-letter selector flips the verdict pair from some/some to none/none with no change to the physical state.
